'''Beta Squadron''' was a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] squadron in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It served [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]] at the [[Battle of Mylok IV|Conflict at Mylok IV]].
